USMLE step 1 preparation intentions, influencing factors, and perceived stress among Pakistani medical students: a cross-sectional study
abstractText: Abstract Background As the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) gains more traction as a route towards acquiring postgraduate training in other countries, it is important to understand several key details.The United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) is a growing option for Pakistani medical students to pursue postgraduate training overseas and here are some important details. Undergraduate medical education can be academically, financially and psychologically challenging. The aims of this study were to evaluate the USMLE Step 1 preparation intentions, influencing factors, and perceived stress among undergraduate medical students. Methods Convenience sampling was used to carry out descriptive cross sectional study among 3rd year, 4th year and 5th year MBBS students of Shifa College of Medicine, Islamabad, with the total sample size of 169. Information was gathered via a structured self-administered questionnaire focused on demographic information, USMLE awareness and intentions, factors influencing examination decision and psychological experiences. The data were summarized using descriptive statistics. The chi-square test or Fisher’s exact test was used to assess associations between perceived stress and categorical variables. The criterion for the statistical significance was p < 0.05. Results The average age of the subjects was 22.20 ± 2.30 years and 56.8% were female. Overall, 97.0% knew about the USMLE, and 68.0% planned to take Step 1. In total, 77.5% of the participants indicated that they would do Step 1 during MBBS. The greatest ratings of motivating factors were for career growth overseas (5, IQR 4–5). Academic year (p = 0.003) and intention to attempt the USMLE (p < 0.001) were significant factors for perceived stress, while gender (p = 0.652) and academic performance (p = 0.756) were not. Conclusion The students surveyed had intentions of taking USMLE step 1. Academic year and examination intention were related to perceived stress. There may be challenges to address which involve preparation; these can be addressed with institutional career guidance and student support.

title: Two-dimensional speckle-tracking imaging for assessing cardiac dysfunction in liver cirrhosis: correlation with Child-Pugh score
abstractText: Abstract Background Although two-dimensional speckle tracking imaging (2D-STI) enables sensitive and quantitative assessment of myocardial deformation, its application in patients with liver cirrhosis (LC) has largely been limited to ventricular function. This study applied 2D-STI to evaluate both ventricular and atrial function in order to identify early myocardial dysfunction in this population. Methods A total of 82 patients with LC were enrolled and stratified according to the Child–Pugh classification into Class A ( n = 30), Class B ( n = 29), and Class C ( n = 23). Thirty healthy individuals served as controls. All 112 participants underwent conventional echocardiography and 2D-STI assessment. Results Compared with controls, all LC groups showed reduced left ventricular global longitudinal strain (LVGLS) and right ventricular free wall longitudinal strain (RVFWLS) (both P < 0.05), with a progressive decline from Class A to Class C. In contrast, right ventricular global longitudinal strain (RVGLS) was significantly decreased only in Classes B and C ( P < 0.05). Left atrial conduit strain (LAScd) was significantly reduced across all LC groups ( P < 0.05), whereas left atrial reservoir strain (LASr) and contractile strain (LASct) demonstrated a biphasic pattern -initially increased, then decreased- compared with controls. Overall, 2D-STI detected cardiac dysfunction earlier than conventional echocardiography. Significant negative correlations were observed between Child–Pugh score and LVGLS, RVFWLS, and RVGLS. Conclusion Cardiac function is impaired in patients with LC and deteriorates with increasing disease severity. Compared with conventional echocardiography, 2D-STI detects cardiac dysfunction at an earlier stage, providing valuable support for early clinical intervention.

title: Closing the Gap: The Utility of Internal Medicine Consult Services in Children’s Hospitals
Social Media Asthma Education to Reduce Pediatric Health Care Use: A Bayesian Randomized Control Trial
abstractText: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES Traditional pediatric asthma education is often fragmented and time limited. Social media may provide a more sustained platform for education. We hypothesized that social media–based education (SME) about asthma would reduce health care use the year after asthma hospitalization METHODS In a 2-center Bayesian randomized trial, caregivers of patients aged 3 to 17 years hospitalized for asthma were randomly assigned to social media plus usual care or usual care alone, stratified by age (3–11 vs 12–17 years) and center. The SME group received at least weekly educational post via Facebook and Instagram. The primary outcome was total number of treatment days in a medical setting within 1 year. Secondary outcomes included treatment days across different settings, time to emergency department (ED) revisit or hospital readmission, missed school days, and patient satisfaction. Analyses were conducted using Bayesian generalized linear models with a neutral prior. RESULTS Two hundred participants were enrolled. Compared with usual care, SME had a 93% probability of reduced total treatment days (relative risk [RR] 0.80; 95% credible interval [CrI], 0.59–1.07) and a 96% probability of decreased unplanned treatment days (RR 0.67; 95% CrI, 0.43–1.05). Mean time to ED revisit was 186 days in controls vs 225 days in the SME arm, with a 92% probability of reduction. Social media participants had longer time to readmission (293 vs 218 days; 81% probability of reduction) and greater satisfaction with education (73% vs 36%) than controls. CONCLUSIONS SME was well accepted and likely reduced health care use and delayed posthospitalization ED visits and readmissions compared with usual care.

title: Adult Care in a Pediatric Hospital: Patterns and Implications of an Internal Medicine Consult Service at a Children’s Hospital
abstractText: OBJECTIVE Adults with childhood-onset conditions are increasingly admitted to children’s hospitals, yet many pediatric systems lack the infrastructure and expertise to manage adult-related medical needs. One approach to bridge this gap is the use of an adult medicine consult service. We aim to describe the demographics, clinical complexity, and consultation patterns of patients admitted to a freestanding children’s hospital and evaluated by an adult medicine consult service, which is a current gap in the literature. PATIENTS AND METHODS A retrospective descriptive cohort study was performed of admitted patients with a Hospital Medicine Adult Care (HMAC) service consult from July 2014 through June 2023. RESULTS Annual adult admissions increased over the study period, from 7.4% to 10.2% of all admissions. HMAC consulted on 1666 admissions for 1008 unique patients (median age, 27 years [range, 14–71 years]). The most frequent reasons for consult were venous thromboembolism prophylaxis (33.7%), age older than 25 years (21.2%), transition of care (7.6%), and hypertension (7.6%). HMAC physicians addressed a mean of 5.5 diagnoses per encounter. Patients averaged 3.6 admissions (range, 1–22) and 4.9 comorbidities (range, 0–21) each. The most common comorbidities were technology dependence (47%), solid tumor malignancy (22.5%), genetic conditions (20.2%), epilepsy (19.7%), congenital heart disease (17.4%), and cerebral palsy (15.7%). CONCLUSIONS Adult consult services in children’s hospitals support a medically complex population with diverse childhood-onset and adult conditions and function as longitudinal clinical partners. These findings support the role of adult medicine expertise in children’s hospitals to help recognize and manage adult-specific care needs and transitions.

title: Swarm intelligence in the evolution of cooperation: a brief survey
abstractText: The emergence and maintenance of cooperation among self-interested individuals remains a central issue in evolutionary biology and social science. The development of swarm intelligence provides a new perspective for understanding how local interactions and adaptive strategy updating shape macroscopic cooperative dynamics. This paper presents a brief survey of swarm intelligence in the evolution of cooperation, with particular attention to swarm-intelligence-based strategy updating in social dilemma games. We examine how representative swarm-intelligence mechanisms incorporate individual, social, and historical information into strategy adaptation, and how such information integration reshapes evolutionary dynamics and cooperative outcomes. We also summarize the common features and current limitations of existing models and discuss several promising directions for future research.

abstractText: Purpose Student suicide is a matter of grave concern in contemporary India. Today, across India, a number of students are dying by suicide due to academic pressure, failure in exams, highly competitive educational system, over-expectations of family and caste discrimination etc. All these catalyse stress, frustration, depression and isolation in the lives of students and lead to suicide. This paper aims to examine the social causes of student suicide in India under the anomie theory. Design/methodology/approach This paper has applied the PRISMA method to map the articles and research papers on the social causes of student suicide. These articles and research papers articulate what student suicide actually is, what the trend of student suicide in India is and how the problem of student suicide should be examined. The social causes identified from selected articles and research papers have been analysed at the micro and macro levels using anomie theory. Findings The findings reveal that many students die by suicide due to high expectations of parents regarding good marks, and their criticism over poor performance. Moreover, it finds that the highly competitive environment of educational institutions and coaching centres and the caste discrimination prevalent that make the students suffer from frustration and inferiority, causing many students to die by suicide. Originality/value This is an original work of the authors. The authors have applied Durkheim’s viewpoint to understand the social causes of suicide among students in India.

title: IMUNIDADE ADAPTATIVA: COMO OS LINFÓCITOS T E B LEMBRAM INFECÇÕES PASSADAS E MELHORAM RESPOSTAS FUTURAS
abstractText: Introdução: o sistema imunológico opera por meio de dois ramos integrados. A imunidade inata responde de forma imediata e inespecífica, enquanto a imunidade adaptativa, mediada por linfócitos T e B, produz uma resposta específica e capaz de gerar memória imunológica, o que permite respostas mais rápidas e eficazes em reexposições ao mesmo antígeno. Objetivo: analisar como os linfócitos T e B registram infecções prévias e de que modo esse registro modifica a magnitude, a velocidade e a qualidade das respostas subsequentes, destacando a interação funcional entre imunidade inata e adaptativa. Materiais e Método: revisão narrativa da literatura, com levantamento bibliográfico nas bases PubMed e SciELO e na ferramenta Google Acadêmico, no recorte temporal de 2000 a 2026, utilizando os descritores imunidade adaptativa, linfócitos T, linfócitos B e memória imunológica, e seus correspondentes em inglês adaptive immunity, T-lymphocytes, B-lymphocytes e immunologic memory. Resultados: a literatura consultada indica que as células apresentadoras de antígeno do sistema inato deflagram a ativação linfocitária e condicionam a qualidade da resposta subsequente; que a memória se estabelece sobretudo nos centros germinativos, por seleção clonal, hipermutação somática e troca de isotipo; e que a resposta secundária difere da primária por menor período de latência, maior magnitude, predomínio de IgG e maior afinidade dos anticorpos, ainda que não mobilize a totalidade do repertório de memória previamente formado. Conclusões: a memória imunológica resulta da cooperação entre os dois ramos do sistema imune, constitui processo dinâmico e não estático, e fundamenta racionalmente as estratégias de imunização e de reforço vacinal.

title: Del riesgo científico al significado social: análisis discursivo de la comunicación sobre microplásticos y bioplásticos
abstractText: Public communication of the environmental properties of bioplastics requires translating technical and scientific concepts into non-specialist discourse. This exploratory qualitative documentary study examines how conditions underpinning statements about biodegradability, compostability and persistent microplastics are retained or reformulated. A pilot corpus of public communications by three manufacturers (BASF, NatureWorks and Novamont) was compared with relevant scientific and technical documentation. The analysis distinguishes between conceptual preservation, the association of technical attributes with environmental values, and potential semantic-epistemic reconfigurations. Some communications explicitly identify standards and application conditions, whereas others emphasize environmental benefits that require additional contextual verification. The study does not establish that these statements are false or misleading. Its contribution is a provisional comparative procedure for assessing the alignment between public claims and their conditions of scientific validity. The limited, non-representative corpus and the pending specialist assessment restrict the scope of the findings.

Prognostic Nutritional Index and stroke-associated pneumonia in acute ischemic stroke: a retrospective cohort study
abstractText: Abstract Background Stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) is a frequent and serious complication following acute ischemic stroke (AIS), associated with prolonged hospitalization and increased mortality. The Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI), a composite marker of nutritional and immunological status, may predict infectious complications, but its non-linear association with SAP and any threshold effect remain uncharacterized. Methods This retrospective cohort study analyzed 1,766 AIS patients admitted between September 2016 and September 2022. Logistic regression assessed the PNI–SAP association. PNI and A2DS2 models were compared using identical additional covariates, and the incremental contribution of PNI was evaluated separately. Internal validation used 1,000 bootstrap resamples. Restricted cubic splines, exploratory piecewise regression, and metabolic sensitivity analyses were performed. Results Among 1,766 patients, 376 (21.3%) developed SAP. Each unit increase in PNI was associated with lower adjusted odds of SAP (OR, 0.913; 95% CI, 0.888–0.938). PNI alone had lower discrimination than the reconstructed A2DS2 score (AUC, 0.666 versus 0.747). With identical additional covariates, PNI and A2DS2 models had AUCs of 0.888 and 0.885 (ΔAUC, 0.0021 (95% CI -0.0079 to 0.0115; approximate P = 0.666)). Adding PNI to A2DS2 with these covariates increased AUC by 0.009 (approximate P = 0.023). The corresponding two-variable increase over the A2DS2 score alone was also 0.009 (95% CI -0.0001 to 0.0256; approximate P = 0.206) and was not statistically significant. The association persisted after metabolic adjustment. The threshold estimate was exploratory. Conclusions Lower PNI was associated with higher odds of SAP. PNI did not demonstrate superior discrimination to A2DS2 under identical additional adjustment. Its incremental discrimination was small, and neither clinical utility nor a treatment threshold was established. External validation is required.

title: Coupled thermal and sorption effects on contaminant breakthrough through geosynthetic and compacted clay liners in municipal solid waste landfills
Diabetes distress, social participation and social inclusion in Type 1 diabetes: a psychosocial framework
abstractText: Purpose Diabetes distress in type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a widespread psychosocial problem that is clinically relevant but also a mental health and social inclusion problem and will be focused on here with a particular focus on adolescents and young adults. It has not been sufficiently theorised around its social implications. A psychosocial approach is suggested in this paper to understand the role of distress in social participation and feeling part of a group/society and provide a direction for psychosocial care. Design/methodology/approach This paper is grounded on the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health and is supported by theories of stress-coping, self-regulation and stigma and develops a conceptual moderated-mediation model and five testable propositions. Findings Diabetes distress can limit social participation by means of protective social withdrawal, which is the avoidance, restriction or concealment of social activity to manage glycaemic risk and the visibility of self-management, especially if diabetes perceived as stigma is expected. Withdrawal is presented as a reaction to the exclusionary conditions, rather than to the causes of the conditions. Relational support and safe disclosure are hypothesised to primarily affect the distress–withdrawal pathway, whereas environmental accommodation is hypothesised to primarily affect the withdrawal–participation pathway. Less participation, such as participation that continues by being hidden, can diminish feelings of belonging and social inclusion. Practical implications The framework highlights four points of psychosocial care and social inclusion practice: reducing distress, addressing avoidance and concealment, strengthening relational support and disclosure and improving environmental accommodation. This is especially important in low and middle income countries like India. Originality/value This paper views diabetes distress as a social inclusion problem, clarifies the distinction between protective social withdrawal, other constructs related to social withdrawal and the criteria for validation and identifies where care and accommodation might breach this.

title: ОЦЕНКА ЭФФЕКТИВНОСТИ ДИНАМИЧЕСКОГО КЛИНИКОЛАБОРАТОРНОГО МОНИТОРИНГА ПАЦИЕНТОВ С САХАРНЫМ ДИАБЕТОМ 2 ТИПА
abstractText: Сахарный диабет 2 типа является одной из актуальных медико-социальных проблем современного здравоохранения, характеризующейся хроническим течением, развитием метаболических нарушений и высоким риском сердечно-сосудистых осложнений, что обусловливает необходимость регулярного клинико-лабораторного мониторинга состояния пациентов. В настоящем исследовании проведён анализ результатов динамического наблюдения 80 пациентов с сахарным диабетом 2 типа в возрасте от 40 до 89 лет, обследованных на базе семейной поликлиники № 4 города Бухары. В процессе наблюдения оценивались изменения показателей углеводного и липидного обмена, биохимических параметров, характеризующих функциональное состояние почек, уровня артериального давления, а также приверженности пациентов к регулярному приёму лекарственных препаратов. Полученные данные свидетельствуют о тенденции к снижению уровня гликемии натощак и общего холестерина, уменьшению доли пациентов, сообщавших о повышении артериального давления, и улучшению показателей соблюдения медикаментозной терапии. Результаты исследования подчёркивают значимость комплексного клинико-лабораторного мониторинга в учреждениях первичной медико-санитарной помощи для своевременного выявления метаболических нарушений, систематической оценки клинического состояния пациентов и совершенствования индивидуализированных подходов к диспансерному наблюдению. Вместе с тем для подтверждения непосредственной связи выявленных положительных изменений с проводимым мониторингом необходимы дополнительные контролируемые исследования. EN Type 2 diabetes mellitus is one of the most pressing medical and social challenges in modern healthcare, characterized by a chronic course, the development of metabolic disorders, and an increased risk of cardiovascular complications, highlighting the need for regular clinical and laboratory monitoring of patients. This study presents an analysis of the results of dynamic follow-up of 80 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus, aged 40 to 89 years, who were examined at Family Polyclinic No. 4 in Bukhara, Uzbekistan. During the follow-up period, changes in carbohydrate and lipid metabolism, biochemical parameters reflecting renal function, blood pressure levels, and patients' adherence to regular medication intake were evaluated. The findings demonstrated a downward trend in fasting blood glucose and total cholesterol levels, a reduction in the proportion of patients reporting elevated blood pressure, and an improvement in medication adherence. The study highlights the importance of comprehensive clinical and laboratory monitoring in primary healthcare settings for the timely detection of metabolic abnormalities, systematic assessment of patients' clinical conditions, and optimization of individualized approaches to long-term follow-up care. Nevertheless, further controlled studies are required to establish a direct relationship between the observed positive changes and the monitoring interventions. title: The Banff Patellofemoral Instability Instrument 2.0: structural validity and responsiveness as a patient-centred tool for assessing recovery after medial patellofemoral ligament reconstruction
abstractText: Aims The study aim was to evaluate the 23-item Banff Patellofemoral Instability Instrument 2.0 (BPII 2.0) to assess patient-reported recovery following medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) reconstruction, including its psychometric properties, sub-scale structure, and cross-sectional responsiveness. Methods A total of 731 patients (828 knees) undergoing MPFL reconstruction completed BPII 2.0, and a sub-set of 526 patients also completed International Knee Documentation Committee (IKDC) Subjective Knee Form, Knee Injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score (KOOS), and Marx Activity Rating Scale (MARS) preoperatively, and at six, 12, and 24 months postoperatively. Evaluation included structural validity via confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), internal consistency, construct validity, and floor/ceiling effects. Cross-sectional responsiveness was assessed using linear mixed models (LMMs). Results CFA supported a five-factor structure and hierarchical second-order model (SRMR < 0.08), supporting both BPII 2.0 sub-scale and total scores. Internal consistency was good-to-excellent (Cronbach’s α: total = 0.93 to 0.97; sub-scales = 0.69 to 0.93). Construct validity was strong. Specifically, BPII 2.0 ‘recreation’, ‘lifestyle’, and ‘social/emotional wellbeing’ sub-scales correlated strongly with KOOS-quality of life ( r = 0.60 to 0.80), and all BPII 2.0 sub-scales correlated strongly with IKDC ( r = 0.52 to 0.79). No floor/ceiling effects (< 15%) were observed. LMM demonstrated significant improvement across all BPII 2.0 domains through 12 months (p < 0.001), with the most rapid increases between preoperative baseline and six months postoperatively. While ‘work/school concerns’, ‘lifestyle’, and ‘social/emotional wellbeing’ scores improved significantly through 24 months (p < 0.05), remaining sub-scales reached clinical equivalence between 12 and 24 months. ‘Recreation’ and ‘social/emotional wellbeing’ consistently yielded the lowest scores. Conclusion The BPII 2.0 is a reliable, valid, and responsive disease-specific instrument for evaluating recovery after MPFL reconstruction. Its multidimensional structure allows assessment of overall and domain-specific outcomes, supporting its use in clinical practice and research across adolescent and adult populations. title: “KITA SIGAP” : Kit Deteksi Residu Antibiotika pada MBG, Integritas Gizi Aman dan Protektif; Terintegrasi Aplikasi Mobile e-KITA SIGAP BPOM sebagai Aksi Nyata Mendukung Program Prioritas Presiden
abstractText: Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) menuntut jaminan keamanan pangan, termasuk risiko residu antibiotika pada bahan pangan asal hewan seperti daging ayam, telur, susu, dan ikan budidaya yang dapat menimbulkan resistansi antimikroba dan dampak kesehatan lainnya. Penelitian ini bertujuan merancang inovasi KITA SIGAP (Kit Deteksi Residu Antibiotika pada MBG, Integritas Gizi Aman dan Protektif) yang terintegrasi dengan aplikasi mobile e-KITA SIGAP BPOM, mengidentifikasi faktor internal dan eksternal pelaksanaannya melalui analisis SWOT, serta merumuskan rekomendasi kebijakan dan rencana implementasi bertahap. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif dengan desain kajian kebijakan terhadap data sekunder yang dikumpulkan melalui studi dokumen dan pustaka, meliputi peraturan perundang-undangan, SNI 7424:2024, pedoman BPOM, laporan pemantauan residu antibiotika, publikasi ilmiah, dan dokumen WHO, yang dianalisis dengan metode SWOT. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan rancangan aplikasi dengan lima menu utama (dashboard dan input data sampel, input hasil uji, pengawasan dan aksi, edukasi dan regulasi, serta pemindai barcode) dan analisis SWOT yang mengidentifikasi sembilan kekuatan, enam kelemahan, lima peluang, dan lima ancaman. KITA SIGAP diharapkan menjadi model pengawasan residu antibiotika yang preventif, responsif, terintegrasi, dan akuntabel, dengan rencana implementasi jangka pendek (pembentukan tim, prototipe, validasi metode, SOP, pilot project) dan jangka menengah (perluasan dan penyempurnaan sistem). Namun, kinerja analitik kit dan aplikasi belum diuji secara empiris sehingga memerlukan validasi dan uji coba lapangan.

title: Symbolic Meanings and Islamic Values in The Dawuhan Ritual at Sumber Gangging from the Perspective of Alfred Schutz’s Social Phenomenology
abstractText: Background/Introduction: The Dawuhan ritual at Sumber Gangging connects local traditions, spiritual experiences, and dependence on water resources, providing a context for examining symbolic meanings and Islamic values. Research Objectives: This study examines participants’ ritual experiences, symbolic meanings, and their relationship with Islamic values. Methodology: A qualitative approach grounded in Alfred Schutz’s social phenomenology was employed through participant observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation. Results: The principal informant’s account connects ritual participation with inherited knowledge, memories, and hopes for safety. Water, collective prayers, and communal cooking and dining provide grounds for interpreting gratitude, mutual assistance (ta‘āwun), and environmental responsibility. However, the available evidence does not establish uniform interpretations among participants or consistent enactment beyond the ritual. Unique Contribution: The study distinguishes recorded practices, informant meanings, and the researcher’s interpretation of Islamic values. Conclusion: Dawuhan provides a setting where local traditions intersect with Islamic ethical orientations, without establishing the normative compatibility of every ritual element. Recommendations: Future research should involve participants across generations and roles, clarify prayer orientations and symbolic interpretations, and investigate everyday spring maintenance.

abstractText: Nghiên cứu đánh giá tiềm năng sử dụng mùn dừa làm giá thể qua hàm lượng lignin và phenolic tổng tại ba thời điểm phơi – lưu trữ. Mùn dừa và xơ dừa được tách bằng máy băm vỏ dừa trục dao nghiêng. Lignin được xác định bằng phương pháp Klason thủy phân acid hai giai đoạn, gồm lignin không tan trong acid (AIL) đo theo khối lượng và lignin tan trong acid (ASL) đo bằng quang phổ; phenolic tổng liên quan đến tannin được xác định bằng Folin–Ciocalteu. Lignin tổng tăng theo thời gian lưu trữ do AIL tăng và ASL giảm, chủ yếu phản ánh sự làm giàu tương đối của lignin khi các thành phần kém bền phân hủy, dù chưa loại trừ khả năng lignin ngưng tụ một phần trong điều kiện phơi – lưu trữ tự nhiên. Đồng thời, hàm lượng chất chiết giảm, còn hàm lượng tro tăng nhẹ. Phenolic tổng trong dịch chiết tăng, cho thấy phơi kéo dài chưa đủ loại bỏ các hợp chất phenolic, bao gồm tannin. Efficacy and Safety of FLACS Versus Conventional Phacoemulsification in Age-Related Cataract: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstractText: Age-related cataract is a leading cause of visual impairment worldwide. Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery (FLACS) has been shown to reduce ultrasound energy exposure during cataract removal; however, the clinical significance of this reduction remains uncertain. This systematic review aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of FLACS with conventional phacoemulsification in adults with age-related cataract. PubMed and Scopus were systematically searched for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) published between January 1, 2023, and July 30, 2026. Two independent reviewers screened the retrieved records and assessed the risk of bias using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tool. Six RCTs involving 564 eyes met the inclusion criteria, and all were assessed as having some concerns regarding risk of bias. In one trial involving patients with dense cataracts, FLACS significantly reduced effective phacoemulsification time (4.42 vs. 6.14 seconds) and was associated with lower corneal endothelial cell loss at six months (12.8% vs. 16.08%). Conversely, another trial reported a longer overall procedural duration with FLACS when the laser pretreatment stage was included. Although some trials demonstrated faster early postoperative visual recovery following FLACS, longer-term visual acuity and refractive predictability were generally comparable between the two surgical techniques. Heterogeneity in cataract density, femtosecond laser platforms, surgical protocols, and follow-up durations limited direct comparisons across studies. Overall, FLACS may reduce ultrasound energy exposure and corneal endothelial cell loss, particularly in patients with dense cataracts. However, the available evidence did not demonstrate a consistent advantage in longer-term visual or refractive outcomes compared with conventional phacoemulsification. Larger, methodologically rigorous RCTs with standardized outcome measures and extended follow-up periods are warranted to further establish the comparative efficacy and safety of these surgical approaches.

title: Unblocking the airway: direct neck lift for lymphedema-associated extrinsic stomal obstruction—a novel therapy for airway management: case report
abstractText: Abstract Background Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is uncommon after total laryngectomy (TL) because airflow bypasses the pharynx and occurs exclusively through the tracheostoma. However, a mechanistically distinct form—extrinsic OSA—may occur when submental adiposity or lymphedema externally compresses the stoma. Case presentation A 61-year-old woman with prior TL developed nocturnal apneas and daytime somnolence from posture-dependent stomal obstruction caused by submental lymphedema and adiposity. Neck flexion produced complete external airway collapse despite tracheal lumen patency. She underwent ​direct​ excision neck lift involving direct skin and subcutaneous tissue excision, suprahyoid lymphadenectomy, submental lipectomy, lateral liposuction, midline platysmal plication, and Z-plasty closure. There were no complications. Over 20 months of follow-up she had near-complete resolution of nocturnal obstruction, improved breathing, a patent stoma in neck flexion, and improved cervicomental contour. Mild, infrequent obstruction persisted due to excess chest wall and breast tissue. Conclusions This case identifies extrinsic stomal obstruction as an underrecognized cause of OSA after TL and suggests that targeted soft-tissue debulking can restore airway patency when conservative measures fail. This represents the first documented case of successful surgical correction for extrinsic stomal obstruction secondary to submental lymphedema. Larger series with objective outcome measures are needed to confirm these findings and define patient selection.

title: Localized Gd 4 f States and Valence-Band Reconstruction across the Antiferromagnetic Transition in GdGe 1.5
abstractText: We investigated the evolution of the electronic structure across the antiferromagnetic transition temperature (T N = 29 K) of the magnetic regenerator material GdGe 1.5 . The Gd L III -edge X-ray absorption spectrum closely resembles that of Gd 2 O 3 , indicating that the Gd ions are predominantly trivalent with highly localized (4f 7 ) electronic states. Consistently, the Gd 4f states observed photoemission spectroscopy measurements exhibit an atomic-like multiplet structure of localized Gd 3+ states. While the Gd 4f peak shifts monotonically with decreasing temperature, the valence-band peak exhibits a reversal of its energy shift across T N . This behavior suggests a reconstruction of the hybridized Gd 5d–Ge 4p electronic states associated with the onset of antiferromagnetic order. These results indicate that the magnetic transition in GdGe 1.5 is not driven by a delocalization of the Gd 4f electrons but is accompanied by a reorganization of the itinerant electronic states coupled to the localized Gd moments.

Высокое нормальное артериальное давление у молодых взрослых представляет собой клинически значимое состояние, при котором раннее выявление модифицируемых факторов риска может способствовать предупреждению развития стойкой артериальной гипертензии. Цель — научно обосновать комплексный подход к стратификации кардиометаболического риска и немедикаментозной профилактике у лиц в возрасте 18–44 лет с высоким нормальным артериальным давлением. Материалы и методы. Проведён аналитический обзор клинических рекомендаций и научных исследований, дополненный разработкой клинико-лабораторного протокола на основе диссертационного обоснования. Протокол предусматривает повторные измерения артериального давления, антропометрию, оценку поведенческих факторов риска, липидного и гликемического профилей, функции почек, уровня hs-СРБ и гомоцистеина, проведение ЭКГ, эхокардиографии и ультразвуковую оценку сосудов по показаниям. Результаты. Сформирована модель последовательной оценки риска, сочетающая подтверждение категории артериального давления, выявление метаболических нарушений и признаков субклинического поражения органов-мишеней, а также определение индивидуальных профилактических вмешательств. Количественные результаты собственных обследований не представлены; эффективность модели требует проспективной проверки. Заключение. Персонализированная профилактика на этапе высокого нормального артериального давления представляет собой обоснованное направление исследования, особенно в молодых возрастных группах. Диагностическая и прогностическая ценность предлагаемого комплекса должна быть установлена на основании фактических клинических данных. EN Background. High-normal blood pressure in young adults represents a clinically significant condition in which early identification of modifiable risk factors may help prevent the development of sustained arterial hypertension. Objective. To provide a scientific rationale for an integrated approach to cardiometabolic risk stratification and non-pharmacological prevention in individuals aged 18–44 years with high-normal blood pressure. Materials and Methods. An analytical review of clinical guidelines and scientific studies was conducted, supplemented by the development of a clinical and laboratory assessment protocol based on the dissertation rationale. The protocol includes repeated blood pressure measurements, anthropometry, assessment of behavioral risk factors, lipid and glycemic profiles, renal function, measurement of highsensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) and homocysteine levels, electrocardiography, echocardiography, and vascular ultrasonography when indicated. Results. A stepwise risk assessment model was developed, combining confirmation of blood pressure category, identification of metabolic disturbances and signs of subclinical target-organ damage, and selection of individualized preventive interventions. Quantitative findings from original patient examinations are not presented; therefore, the effectiveness of the proposed model requires prospective validation. Conclusion. Personalized prevention at the stage of high-normal blood pressure represents a scientifically justified research direction, particularly in younger adult populations. The diagnostic and prognostic value of the proposed assessment framework should be established using actual clinical data. UZ Dolzarbligi. Penerapan Integrasi Lean Warehousing dan Employee Behavior untuk Meningkatkan Kinerja Operasional PT. CRP
abstractText: PT CRP merupakan suatu perusahaan warehouse yang mendistribusikan karpet di Indonesia. Kelancaran operasional pergudangan ditentukan oleh kelancaran, efektif, dan efisien dari kegiatan-kegiatan yang terdapat pada sistem kerjanya dan diukur kinerjanya. Kinerja yang diukur adalah komplain pelanggan dan produktivitas sehingga mempersingkat waktu proses operasi sangat penting. Tahapan proses operasional meliputi receiving, put away, sales order, picking, packing, dan dispatching. PT CRP menghadapi tantangan untuk memperbaiki kinerjanya karena adanya hambatan, pemborosan di alur kerja operasinya, seperti pergerakan karyawan yang tidak perlu, waktu tunggu barang yang lama di setiap tahapan proses, adanya ekstra proses, kompetensi karyawan kurang, kurangnya koordinasi antarbagian, operator sering mengobrol, terjadi bullying, adanya penerimaan/pengeluaran barang secara bersamaan dan sebagainya. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pemborosan-pemborosan (wastes) yang terjadi melalui integrasi lean warehousing dan employee behavior yang menyentuh aspek socio-technical system untuk meningkatkan kinerja operasionalnya. Integrasi ini memadukan interaksi unsur sosial unsur teknis. Hasil analisis permasalahan dan prioritas perbaikan dengan menggunakan pembobotan berdasarkan importance, urgency, priority (IUP) matrix kemudian dilakukan perbaikan pada pengaturan alur kerja operasi, evaluasi kategori barang fast moving, pengaturan tempat penyimpanan, pembinaan perilaku karyawan dan lain-lain. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan dampak positif terhadap kinerja yaitu efisiensi waktu proses sebesar 50,4% karena terjadinya penurunan waktu aktivitas non-value added dari 1 jam 21 menit menjadi 37 menit dan mempersingkat waktu proses dari 2 jam 13 menit menjadi 1 jam 06 menit. Hal ini berdampak pada adanya perbaikan waktu aktivitas value added sebesar 38,1%. Penerapan pendekatan sosio-teknis dengan mengintegrasikan lean warehouse dan employee behavior mampu meningkatkan kinerja operasi PT CRP dengan adanya peningkatan produktivitas sebesar 40,2% dan komplain mengalami penurunan 65%.

title: Factors Influencing QRIS Use in Indonesia: An Extended UTAUT2 Approach
abstractText: The development of digital payment systems in Indonesia has encouraged changes in consumer transaction behavior toward methods that are faster, more practical, and increasingly integrated. One of the rapidly developing innovations is the Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS), which enables users to make digital payments through various payment applications using a standardized QR code. Although QRIS adoption continues to increase, sustainable usage is not determined solely by technological factors but is also influenced by users’ behavioral characteristics and financial capabilities. This study aims to analyze the factors influencing behavioral intention and actual use of QRIS in Indonesia by applying the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2) model, extended with financial literacy and perceived behavioral control. This quantitative study employed a survey method involving 728 QRIS users in Indonesia. The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with the assistance of SmartPLS software. The results indicate that performance expectancy, social influence, price value, habit, financial literacy, and perceived behavioral control have positive and significant effects on behavioral intention. In contrast, effort expectancy, facilitating conditions, and hedonic motivation do not have significant effects on behavioral intention. Furthermore, financial literacy, perceived behavioral control, and behavioral intention have positive and significant effects on actual use. Among all variables examined, habit is the most dominant factor influencing behavioral intention, while behavioral intention is the strongest predictor of actual use. These findings indicate that sustainable QRIS usage is influenced not only by the functional benefits of the technology but also by users’ habits, financial literacy, and perceived control over the use of digital payment technology. This study contributes to the development of UTAUT2 in the context of digital payments and provides practical implications for payment service providers, regulators, businesses, and consumers in strengthening the sustainable adoption and use of QRIS in Indonesia.

title: The Effectiveness of Classical Guidance Services Using Self-Reflection Techniques to Enhance Self-Disclosure among Grade X Students at SMAN 6 Pandeglang
abstractText: Self-disclosure enables adolescents to communicate their thoughts, feelings, and experiences, yet tenth-grade students at SMAN 6 Pandeglang remain hesitant to share their concerns. This study aimed to describe students’ self-disclosure and examine the potential of classroom guidance incorporating self-reflection to improve this ability. A quasi-experimental nonequivalent control group design was employed, involving 72 students selected through purposive sampling and comprising 36 students in each group. Data were collected using a self-disclosure scale and analysed using t-tests. The experimental group’s mean score increased from 95.83 at pretest to 110.08 at posttest, while the control group’s mean increased from 100.61 to 103.92. A paired-samples t-test indicated a statistically significant pretest–posttest increase within the experimental group (p < .001). This observed improvement suggests that classroom guidance incorporating self-reflection may support students’ self-disclosure. The study provides contextual evidence for integrating self-reflection into school guidance and counselling services, with potential implications for supporting adolescents’ self-awareness and interpersonal communication.

title: SUT BEZI SARATONINI ERTA ANIQLASHDA O'Z-O'ZINI TEKSHIRISH VA SUT BEZI SALOMATLIGIDAN XABARDORLIKNING AHAMIYATI
abstractText: Sut bezi saratoni ayollar orasida keng tarqalgan onkologik kasalliklardan biri bo'lib, uni erta aniqlash davolash samaradorligini oshirish va kasallikning salbiy oqibatlarini kamaytirishda muhim ahamiyatga ega. Mazkur maqolada sut bezini o'z-o'zini tekshirish tushunchasi, uning klinik ahamiyati, sut bezi saratonining dastlabki belgilari hamda ushbu jarayonning zamonaviy skrining usullari bilan o'zaro bog'liqligi tahlil qilindi. Xalqaro klinik tavsiyalar va ilmiy adabiyotlar asosida o'z-o'zini tekshirishning mustaqil skrining usuli sifatidagi cheklovlari hamda sut bezi salomatligi to'g'risida xabardorlikning ahamiyati yoritildi. Ayollar orasida mammologik xabardorlikni oshirish, shubhali klinik belgilarni aniqlash va diagnostik tekshiruvlarga o'z vaqtida yo'naltirish bo'yicha amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqildi. EN Breast cancer is one of the most common malignancies among women. Early detection is essential for improving treatment outcomes and reducing the adverse consequences of the disease. Breast health awareness, knowledge of early clinical signs, and timely medical consultation are important components of early diagnosis. This article examines the concept of breast self-examination, its clinical significance, the early signs of breast cancer, and the relationship between self-examination and modern screening methods. Based on international clinical recommendations and scientific literature, the limitations of breast self-examination as an independent screening method and the importance of breast health awareness are analyzed. Practical recommendations are proposed to improve breast health awareness among women, identify suspicious clinical signs, and ensure timely referral for diagnostic assessment. Его раннее выявление имеет важное значение для повышения эффективности лечения и снижения неблагоприятных последствий заболевания. Осведомлённость о здоровье молочных желёз, знание ранних клинических признаков заболевания и своевременное обращение за медицинской помощью являются важными компонентами ранней диагностики. На основе международных клинических рекомендаций и научной литературы проанализированы ограничения самообследования как самостоятельного метода скрининга и раскрыто значение осведомлённости о здоровье молочных желёз. title: Politik Urban Hunian Publik dan Partisipasi Warga Rusunawa Rajawali di Kota Makassar
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis praktik tata kelola pengelolaan Rusunawa Rajawali Kota Makassar dengan menitikberatkan pada aspek partisipasi warga, keadilan, transparansi, dan akuntabilitas dalam perspektif politik urban. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode studi kasus melalui observasi, wawancara mendalam, dan dokumentasi. Analisis dilakukan menggunakan konsep Right to the City dan Democratic Urban Politics untuk menjelaskan relasi antara pemerintah, pengelola, dan warga penghuni dalam pengelolaan hunian publik. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa mekanisme partisipasi warga telah tersedia melalui forum musyawarah, namun belum berlangsung secara inklusif dan merata. Keadilan dalam pelayanan dan pengambilan keputusan belum sepenuhnya dirasakan seluruh penghuni, sementara transparansi pengelolaan masih memerlukan penguatan guna meningkatkan kepercayaan publik. Penelitian juga menemukan rendahnya keterlibatan generasi muda serta adanya potensi konflik laten akibat perbedaan kepentingan antar aktor. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan penguatan tata kelola kolaboratif yang mendorong partisipasi bermakna, transparansi, akuntabilitas, serta perlindungan terhadap kelompok rentan guna mewujudkan pengelolaan Rusunawa yang inklusif, demokratis, dan berkelanjutan.

title: Extended Memory and Mediatized Sonic Dramaturgy in Krapp’s Last Tape
abstractText: This article examines how the tape recorder in Samuel Beckett’s Krapp’s Last Tape functions both as an extended of autobiographical memory and as a dramaturgical mechanism. Using an interpretive qualitative design, the study conducts a dramaturgical textual analysis of the stage directions, live voice, recorded voice, ledger, box, spool, and silence, as well as the operations of play, stop, rewind, fast-forward, replay, and record. The analytical framework combines the Extended Mind as a cognitive foundation, Seda Ilter’s mediatized dramaturgy as the primary dramaturgical framework, and sonic dramaturgy as a supporting perspective. The findings show that Krapp’s memory is stored within a layered external system, yet the continuity of the archive does not produce continuity of the self. The operations of the tape allow the past to be selected, interrupted, skipped, and replayed, thereby organizing temporality, rhythm, the distribution of voice, and the relationship between the present Krapp and the recorded Krapp. This study extends the concept of mediatized dramaturgy by demonstrating that mediatization can operate through the operational logic of analog media, transforming externalized memory into a structure of dramatic action.

Trauma-Informed Care for Perinatal Psychological Trauma: Application Progress and Public Health Strategies
abstractText: Perinatal psychological trauma has emerged as a critical public health concern with profound implications for maternal and child health as well as intergenerational trauma transmission. Trauma-Informed Care (TIC), operating as a universal prevention-oriented healthcare management framework, shows significant promise in restoring a sense of safety, mitigating perinatal post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and advancing health equity. This narrative review synthesizes current research progress on the multidimensional characteristics and population-level burden of perinatal trauma, analyzes the core concepts and implementation frameworks of TIC, summarizes validated screening and assessment instruments, and thoroughly examines practical bottlenecks—including primary healthcare workforce shortages, socio-cultural stigma, and cross-sectoral referral fragmentation—along with corresponding coping strategies. Ultimately, this review aims to clarify the conceptual boundaries and theoretical foundations of TIC, providing an evidence-based framework to accelerate the translation of TIC principles from micro-level clinical operations into standardized, integrated public health systems.

title: Berwakaf Melalui Asuransi Syariah: Suatu Analisis Kajian Sosial Masyarakat
abstractText: Penelitian ini menganaliasis tentang kajian wakaf melalui asuransi syariah dengan pendekatan sosial masyarakat. Wakaf melalui asuransi syariah merupakan salah satu inovasi instrumen keuangan sosial Islam yang menggabungkan proteksi risiko dengan amal jariyah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis faktor-faktor yang mempengaruhi minat masyarakat dalam berwakaf melalui asuransi syariah. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode studi kasus dan wawancara mendalam. Informan penelitian terdiri dari nasabah asuransi syariah, praktisi/agen asuransi syariah, serta nazhir wakaf. Hasil analisis menunjukkan bahwa minat masyarakat dipengaruhi oleh beberapa faktor utama: pertama tingkat religiusitas dan motivasi spiritual, kedua tingkat kepercayaan (trust) terhadap lembaga asuransi dan nazhir, serta ketiga faktor pendorong eksternal seperti peran sosialisasi dan kemudahan produk. Temuan ini mengindikasikan bahwa meskipun potensi wakaf asuransi syariah sangat besar, hambatan utamanya masih terletak pada rendahnya literasi produk yang kompleks.

Tecnologías y racionalidades en disputa: tensiones éticas, cognitivas y algorítmicas en la integración de la IA en la educación superior
abstractText: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education raises ethical, pedagogical, and political challenges that exceed the instrumental level and point to the technological rationalities guiding its integration. The aim is to analyze the theoretical and practical tensions present in the literature published between 2022 and 2025. An analytical review was conducted, with a hermeneutic-interpretive analysis of 43 sources selected from 89 reviewed, organized around three axes: cognitive delegation, the reconfiguration of teaching work, and algorithmic bias as hidden curriculum. The findings show consensus on the transformative role of AI, but an uneven distribution of evidence, in which algorithmic bias is the least addressed dimension. The three tensions do not operate in isolation, but as expressions of a single dispute over the meaning of higher education. It concludes that integrating AI is a political and epistemic decision that demands critical pedagogies capable of contesting the rationalities at stake.

title: Evaluasi Dampak SMOTE dan Analisis Kebocoran Data pada Prediksi Cacat Perangkat Lunak Berbasis Extra Trees dan Random Forest Menggunakan Dataset NASA KC1
abstractText: Prediksi cacat perangkat lunak membantu menentukan modul yang perlu diuji terlebih dahulu, namun dataset NASA KC1 bersifat tidak seimbang dan mengandung banyak baris duplikat yang dapat menggelembungkan skor evaluasi. Penelitian ini mengevaluasi dampak oversampling berbasis SMOTE terhadap model Extra Trees dan Random Forest, serta mengukur dua jenis kebocoran data. Dataset KC1 dibersihkan dari duplikat sehingga menyusut dari 2.109 menjadi 1.186 modul unik (25% cacat). Empat model diuji menggunakan validasi silang 10-lipatan berulang tiga kali dengan uji-t terkoreksi Nadeau–Bengio. Hasil menunjukkan SMOTE meningkatkan recall Extra Trees dari 0,328 menjadi 0,434, namun menurunkan precision dari 0,580 menjadi 0,502. Nilai Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) dan AUC relatif stabil di angka 0,304 dan 0,736, tanpa perbedaan signifikan antara Extra Trees dan Random Forest. Sebaliknya, kebocoran data terbukti mendongkrak performa secara artifisial, di mana SMOTE sebelum pembagian data menaikkan AUC hingga 0,896 dan MCC dari 0,304 hingga 0,608, sedangkan duplikat menaikkan AUC dari 0,799 menjadi 0,833. Disimpulkan bahwa SMOTE menggeser titik kerja model ke arah recall yang lebih tinggi dengan mengorbankan precision, sehingga penanganan duplikasi dan prosedur validasi ketat sangat krusial dalam evaluasi model prediksi cacat perangkat lunak.

A Study on the Impact of Social Media Data Mining from the Douban Platform on Book Topic Planning
abstractText: Against the backdrop of “Internet Plus,” this study analyzes reader needs using data from Douban’s Top 250 books. Through Python-based data collection, text mining, and statistical analysis, it identifies two themes: individual life narratives and emotional resonance, and social structure and reality reflection. Findings reveal differences in emotional responses across book types, but no significant correlation between immediate emotions and ratings. The study demonstrates the value of user-generated content in informing publishing decisions and book selection.

title: From MyPlate to "Real Food": Major Reforms, Scientific Controversies, and Public Nutrition Policy Implications of the 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans
abstractText: Objective: To systematically characterize the major changes in the 2025–2030 DGA relative to the 2020–2025 edition, evaluate the consistency of these changes with the 2025 Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee (DGAC) Scientific Report, assess the consumer-communication implications of the new inverted-pyramid graphic, and draw evidence-based lessons for other national dietary guidelines. Methods: A structured documentary comparative analysis was conducted. Ten a priori analytic dimensions (communication strategy, graphic tool, protein, added sugars, dairy, fat quality, alcohol, degree of food processing, whole grains, and sodium) were coded independently by two analysts using a standardized extraction template; discrepancies were resolved by consensus. Quantifiable recommendations were converted to absolute daily amounts using a 2,000-kcal/d reference diet and a 70-kg reference adult. Consistency with the DGAC Scientific Report was classified as adopted, partially adopted, or divergent for each contested domain. Sources were restricted to the two DGA editions, the DGAC Scientific Report, the Scientific Foundation document, and peer-reviewed or official commentaries. Results: Eight major shifts were identified: (1) consumer-facing advice for the first time in 25 years; (2) an inverted food pyramid replacing MyPlate; (3) a population-wide protein target of 1.2–1.6 g/kg body weight/day for adults and children, a 50–100% increase over the previous 0.8 g/kg benchmark; (4) added-sugar limits tightened from <10% of energy (~50 g/d) to ≤10 g per meal (~30 g/d across three main meals, excluding snacks governed by separate FDA "healthy" claim criteria), with avoidance before age 10; (5) endorsement of unsweetened full-fat dairy (3 servings/d), reversing decades of low-fat/fat-free guidance; (6) alcohol guidance without numeric limits; (7) the first explicit restriction of "highly processed foods"; and (8) retention of the <10% saturated-fat ceiling alongside prominent visual placement of red meat, butter, and beef tallow. The protein target was introduced at the policy stage and was not recommended by the DGAC; recent expert reviews judge the evidence insufficient for a universal population-wide recommendation. The DGAC's calls to prioritize plant proteins and to strengthen alcohol caution were weakened or omitted in the final text. Conclusions: The 2025–2030 DGA represents a substantive, on balance positive reform on added sugars, highly processed foods, and refined carbohydrates, but a mixed or regressive one on alcohol messaging, saturated-fat communication, and the universality of the protein target. Its public health value will be determined by implementation in federal nutrition programs, industry reformulation responses, and longitudinal dietary monitoring. For other countries, the edition offers both a model (per-meal sugar thresholds, explicit processing-level restrictions) and a cautionary lesson (the risks of graphic-visual messaging that outruns the quantitative text).

title: Finite element analysis of different subtrochanteric osteotomy techniques in total hip arthroplasty for high hip dislocation
abstractText: Aims Subtrochanteric shortening osteotomy in total hip arthroplasty (THA) for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) has variable outcomes. This study evaluated the initial stability of seven different osteotomy techniques. Methods A 3D finite element model of a femur with a stem was created. Seven models simulating osteotomies with different angles (0°, 45°, 90°, -90°, 120°, -120°, z-shaped) were analyzed. Outcomes included range of motion (ROM), bone/implant stress, and osteotomy surface separation. Results The 0° model had the greatest ROM (lowest stiffness). The z-shaped and -90° designs provided the best rotational stability. Analysis of the centre of rotation showed single-symmetric models (45°, z-shaped) shifted laterally, suggesting a ‘windshield wiper’ effect, while double-symmetric models (90°, -90°, 120°, -120°) stayed aligned with the prosthesis axis. Stress patterns differed: single-symmetric models concentrated stress on the lesser trochanter, while double-symmetric models stressed the greater trochanter, with a notable ring in the -90° design. Implant stresses were similar, except in the horizontal model. The -90° and 90° models had the least osteotomy separation, unlike the 45° model. Conclusion No single osteotomy technique outperformed others in all metrics. The z-shaped and -90° designs offered the best rotational stability; the -90° and 90° designs minimized axial separation; the 45° model showed the worst ‘windshield wiper’ effect. The 120° technique provided a balanced profile with moderate rotational stability, acceptable separation, and less pronounced stress rings, representing a reasonable compromise. The choice should be guided by clinical priorities. Cite this article: Bone Joint Res 2026;15(11):1364–1373.

title: FATORES ASSOCIADOS AO ATRASO NO TEMPO PORTA-AGULHA EM PACIENTES COM AVC ISQUÊMICO
abstractText: O tempo porta-agulha representa um componente central da resposta hospitalar ao acidente vascular cerebral isquêmico submetido à trombólise intravenosa. Esta pesquisa bibliográfica analisou 19 estudos publicados entre 2022 e 2026, selecionados mediante busca estruturada da literatura, buscando identificar fatores clínicos, assistenciais, estruturais e organizacionais relacionados ao prolongamento desse intervalo e às possibilidades de redução do atraso intra-hospitalar. Os estudos mostraram que o atraso não decorre de um único componente. Foram identificadas associações com apresentação neurológica flutuante, fibrilação atrial prévia, início desconhecido dos sintomas, reconhecimento inadequado na triagem, ausência de alerta pré-hospitalar, chegada noturna, demora para imagem, sequenciamento de exames avançados e organização das equipes responsáveis pela trombólise. As estratégias mais consistentemente relacionadas à redução do tempo porta-agulha envolveram reorganização do fluxo, tratamento na área de imagem, equipes dedicadas, teleneurologia, comunicação digital, protocolos operacionais, kits móveis de trombólise e projetos de melhoria da qualidade. Entretanto, resultados divergentes quanto ao trombolítico utilizado e a algumas intervenções reforçam a dependência do contexto assistencial.

Effectiveness of Giberellic Acid (GA3) Hormone and Biofertilizer (Bioneensis) on the Growth of Oil Palm Seedlings (Elaeis guineensis Jacq)
abstractText: The nursery phase of oil palm (Elaeis guineensis Jacq.) cultivation represents a substantial cost in plantation establishment, and accelerating seedling growth may improve production efficiency. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of gibberellic acid (GA?) and Bioneensis biofertilizer in promoting the vegetative growth of oil palm seedlings in the main nursery. The experiment was conducted from March to June 2025 in Deli Serdang, North Sumatra, Indonesia, using six-month-old DxP PPKS 540 oil palm seedlings grown in polybags containing 20 kg of topsoil. A factorial randomized complete block design (RCBD) was employed with two factors: GA? concentrations (0, 100, 150, 200, and 250 ppm) and Bioneensis application rates (0, 25, 50, 75, and 100 g), applied at two-week intervals. The experiment consisted of 25 treatment combinations with two replications. Data were analyzed using analysis of variance (ANOVA) at a 5% significance level, followed by Duncan's multiple range test (DMRT). The results indicated that both treatments significantly affected plant height, stem diameter, leaf number, and leaf dry weight. The combination of GA? at 250 ppm and Bioneensis at 75 g (G250B75) produced the best overall vegetative growth, with 15 leaves, a stem diameter of 71.15 mm, a plant height of 120 cm, and the highest leaf dry weight of 227.5 g. However, the greatest plant height (144.5 cm) was observed under the G250B50 treatment. Bioneensis applied at 75 g was also associated with soil potassium and nitrogen concentrations of 21.52 ppm and 0.06%, respectively. These findings suggest that the combined application of GA? at 250 ppm and Bioneensis at 75 g may enhance the vegetative growth of oil palm seedlings and potentially reduce the nursery period from 12 to 9 months, although further validation is required to confirm this reduction.

Determinasi Keputusan Investasi Generasi Z melalui Literasi Keuangan dan Perilaku Keuangan: Studi pada Mahasiswa Universitas Negeri Surabaya
abstractText: Perencanaan suatu investasi untuk mengelola keuangan pribadi ialah sebuah aspek yang sangat baik untuk mengelola keuangan bagi Generasi Z. Kajian penelitian ini bertujuan “untuk mengetahui bagaimana pengaruh literasi keuangan dan perilaku keuangan terhadap keputusan investasi pada Generasi Z.” Populasi yang dikaji yaitu pada mahasiswa Universitas Negeri Surabaya Tahun 2023-2025. Pada konteks Theory of Planned Behavior. Studi kuantitatif ini menerapkan data primer dari kuesioner berskala Likert 5 poin yang diisi oleh 274 mahasiswa, dipilih melalui metode non probability sampling yang menerapkan pendekatan purposive sampling. Data diproses melalui regresi linier berganda berbantuan IBM SPSS 27. Temuan yang ada menegaskan literasi keuangan berpengaruh positif terhadap keputusan investasi. Kemudian, perilaku keuangan keuangan terbukti berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan investasi di kalangan Generasi Z Mahasiswa Universitas Negeri Surabaya. Temuan yang ada menekankan perlunya faktor psikologis dan teknologi untuk menunjang keterlibatan investasi pada generasi muda.

title: RELAÇÃO ENTRE TEMPERATURA AMBIENTE, FADIGA PERCEBIDA E DESEMPENHO AUTORREFERIDO EM PRATICANTES DE CORRIDA DE RUA
abstractText: A temperatura ambiente é um fator capaz de influenciar as respostas fisiológicas e perceptivas durante a prática de exercícios físicos, podendo afetar a percepção de esforço, a fadiga e o desempenho dos praticantes. Nesse contexto, o presente estudo teve como objetivo analisar a relação entre a temperatura ambiente, a fadiga percebida e o desempenho autorreferido em praticantes de corrida de rua. Trata-se de uma pesquisa quantitativa, observacional e transversal, realizada com 201 praticantes de corrida de rua maiores de 18 anos. A coleta de dados foi realizada por meio de questionário estruturado aplicado online, contendo informações sociodemográficas e questões relacionadas à percepção de esforço, fadiga e influência da temperatura durante os treinos. Os dados foram analisados por meio de estatística descritiva e inferencial, utilizando o software Jamovi. Os resultados demonstraram que 84,6% dos participantes relataram aumento da fadiga em ambientes quentes, enquanto 78,6% perceberam piora do desempenho em temperaturas elevadas. Além disso, 74,1% afirmaram reduzir a intensidade ou a duração dos treinos em dias quentes e 66,2% relataram desconforto térmico suficiente para impedir a continuidade da atividade. Também foram identificadas associações entre a percepção de calor, o aumento da fadiga, o desconforto térmico e a piora do desempenho autorreferido. Na discussão, os achados foram relacionados à literatura científica, que aponta o estresse térmico como um fator capaz de aumentar as demandas fisiológicas e perceptivas durante o exercício. Conclui-se que a percepção de temperaturas elevadas está associada a respostas desfavoráveis durante a corrida de rua, reforçando a importância de considerar as condições ambientais no planejamento dos treinamentos e na orientação dos praticantes. Entretanto, os resultados devem ser interpretados considerando o delineamento transversal e a utilização de informações autorreferidas.

A supercapacitor-assisted cyclic battery recharging method for solar and wind power systems
abstractText: The efficient use of solar and wind electricity in stand-alone power systems for remote facilities is limited during periods of reduced generation, when the source voltage may fall below the activation threshold of the charge controller. Under such conditions, direct battery recharging becomes impossible despite the availability of residual energy from the renewable source. This paper investigates a cyclic battery recharging method based on preliminary energy accumulation in supercapacitor modules and their subsequent discharge into the battery. The proposed approach was evaluated using a MATLAB/Simulink simulation model and a physical experimental setup with 166 F and 500 F supercapacitor modules and lead-acid batteries. The results show that preliminary energy storage in supercapacitor modules followed by controlled discharge enables additional battery recharging when the source voltage is insufficient for direct charging through the controller. For the 166 F modules, the duration of the complete first cycle was approximately 8.3 min, while for the 500 F modules it was approximately 28.5 min. Repeated cycles started from the residual voltage of the supercapacitor modules, which reduced the duration of the subsequent charging stages. The deviation between the simulated and experimental voltage characteristics did not exceed 3.5% in the most important operating regions and remained below 7.4% in the other regions. The proposed method is based on voltage-threshold switching logic; in the physical setup, switching was performed manually, while automated implementation is considered as a direction for future research.

Ethnoscience Reconstruction of Sasak Cengeh Cooking for Contextual Chemistry Learning
abstractText: Ethnoscience reconstructions of traditional cooking can connect local knowledge to chemistry, but often leave unclear which claims derive from field records, established ingredient chemistry, or untested predictions. This bounded qualitative case study developed an evidence-graded interpretation of Sasak Cengeh preparation using one completed interview report from one household practitioner in Bunkate, Lombok, Indonesia, and six preparation/product photographs contained in that same report. The report and photographs were read as a single source package, not independently triangulated observations. Reported actions were assigned stage codes (D), related cautiously to published chemical mechanisms (L), and converted into propositions requiring new measurements (H). Six reported stages covered coconut grating, ingredient preparation, spice grinding, heating coconut milk and seasonings, adding vegetables after boiling, and serving. The resulting proposed matrix links these steps to coconut-milk emulsions, taro starch and oxalate, garlic sulfur chemistry, chili capsaicinoids, eggplant phenolics, and metabolites formed during prior shrimp-paste fermentation. It also identifies uncertainties in botanical identification, cooking conditions, and food-safety interpretation. Four untested inquiry tasks were specified for possible upper-secondary chemistry use, each requiring subsequent expert and classroom validation. No chemical assay, independent observation, or educational intervention was performed. The contribution is therefore a transparent single-case method for distinguishing documented practice from literature-based explanation and testable hypotheses, not proof of new reactions or learning effects.

title: MUDANÇAS CLIMÁTICAS, EVENTOS EXTREMOS E PRODUÇÃO DE BIOMASSA: IMPACTOS, VULNERABILIDADES E ESTRATÉGIAS DE ADAPTAÇÃO
abstractText: As mudanças climáticas têm provocado alterações nas condições ambientais e ampliado preocupações relacionadas à ocorrência de eventos extremos e aos seus efeitos sobre os sistemas naturais e produtivos. Este estudo caracteriza-se como uma revisão bibliográfica, de abordagem qualitativa e caráter descritivo, com o objetivo de analisar os impactos das mudanças climáticas e dos eventos extremos sobre a produção de biomassa, considerando as principais vulnerabilidades e estratégias de adaptação. A discussão contempla alterações nos regimes de temperatura e precipitação, secas, ondas de calor, chuvas intensas e outros eventos capazes de interferir na disponibilidade hídrica, no desenvolvimento vegetal e na produtividade de sistemas agrícolas, florestais e destinados à produção energética. Os estudos analisados indicam que os efeitos climáticos não ocorrem de maneira uniforme, uma vez que dependem das características ambientais, das espécies cultivadas, das condições socioeconômicas e da capacidade de adaptação dos sistemas produtivos. Nesse contexto, práticas de conservação do solo e da água, diversificação produtiva, seleção de espécies mais tolerantes às condições adversas, sistemas integrados de produção e utilização de tecnologias de monitoramento climático constituem estratégias relevantes para reduzir vulnerabilidades. Conclui-se que a adaptação da produção de biomassa às mudanças climáticas exige planejamento, conhecimento científico, manejo adequado dos recursos naturais e desenvolvimento de sistemas produtivos mais resilientes, capazes de responder às alterações ambientais sem ampliar a degradação dos ecossistemas.

title: The Effect of Work-Life Balance and Workload on the Learning Effectiveness of Generation Z Students Who Work While Studying in Yogyakarta City
abstractText: Generation Z students who combine employment with university study must navigate overlapping academic, work, and personal responsibilities, making role balance and workload relevant to learning effectiveness. This study examined the associations of work-life balance and workload with learning effectiveness among working Generation Z students in Yogyakarta City. A quantitative survey involved 100 respondents selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected using a five-point Likert-scale questionnaire and analyzed through multiple linear regression in SPSS version 26.0. Work-life balance was positively and significantly associated with learning effectiveness, whereas workload showed no statistically significant independent association. The overall regression model was statistically significant, with an adjusted R² of .399, indicating 39.9% explained variance after adjustment. These findings highlight work-life balance as a relevant factor in understanding learning effectiveness among students managing concurrent employment and academic responsibilities. The study contributes contextual evidence on the relationship between role balance and learning among working Generation Z students. Its practical implications include strengthening students’ time management and prioritization and enhancing university support for students combining work and study.

title: Research and Engineering Implementation of Motion Physical-Quantity Feedback-Based Speed Compensation Control Technology for Precision Liquid Delivery in IVD Medical Equipment
abstractText: Precision liquid delivery is a critical capability in In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) medical equipment, essential for sample dispensing, reagent distribution, and microfluidic driving. However, periodic fluctuations, repeatability errors, and nonuniform advancement during liquid delivery severely compromise dispensing accuracy and test consistency. Conventional continuous speed control and standard closed-loop systems struggle to effectively compensate for mechanical structural errors, lead-screw periodic errors, motor microstepping inaccuracies, and fluidic-load disturbances. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes a novel motion physical-quantity feedback-based speed compensation control method for precision liquid delivery mechanisms. The proposed approach divides the motor-driving process into discrete motion units, assigning independent speed parameters to form a dynamically correctable execution sequence. During operation, actual motion results are acquired via physical quantities such as encoder period, flow rate, pressure, and displacement. Compensation coefficients are calculated from target deviations to correct subsequent motion units. Furthermore, multi-cycle learning is employed for highly repeatable systematic errors to generate a stable speed compensation table. Experimental validation using an IVD precision syringe pump system demonstrates significant reductions in encoder-disk periodic fluctuation and liquid-output nonuniformity. Following compensation, the coefficient of variation (CV) decreased from approximately 0.6% to 0.05%, representing a tenfold improvement in system stability. Ultimately, this method offers low implementation complexity, robust engineering adaptability, and embedded deployability, providing a highly stable, practically implementable motion-control solution for precision dispensing and multi-channel liquid control in modern IVD medical equipment.

Mercury isotope variation during coal formation and combustion of Australian coals
abstractText: Environmental context Mercury isotopes are increasingly used to trace mercury sources and environmental cycling, but Australian coals remain poorly represented in the global mercury isotope record. This study adds new isotope data for Australian lignite and bituminous coals to the global coal mercury isotope framework, with additional observations from lignite combustion. These data provide additional context for interpreting coal-derived mercury isotope signatures. Abstract This study presents a comprehensive mercury (Hg) isotope dataset for Australian lignite and bituminous coals and examines isotope behaviour during the lignite combustion. Total Hg concentrations are approximately two-fold higher in lignite than in bituminous coal. Australian coals extend the global isotopic range towards more negative Δ199Hg values, while preserving the global mass-independent fractionation (MIF) relationship. During combustion of lignite, strong mass-dependent fractionation (MDF) was observed in the solid residues, with heavier Hg enrichment in bottom ash and lighter Hg enrichment in fly ash. No resolvable change in Δ199Hg was observed between feed coal and solid combustion residues within analytical uncertainty.
