title: The effect of palliative care on perceived life expectancy and anxious thoughts in patients with heart failure: randomized controlled trial
abstractText: Abstract Background Heart failure significantly impairs the physical, cognitive, psychological, and social well-being of the aging population. Given the reduced perceived life expectancy and increased anxious thoughts associated with heart failure, optimal patient care is crucial. This study aimed to determine the effect of palliative care on perceived life expectancy and anxious thoughts among patients with heart failure hospitalized within cardiology departments of hospitals affiliated with Kerman University of Medical Sciences in 2024. Materials and methods Eighty patients with heart failure were randomly allocated to either an intervention group or a control group using block randomization. Baseline data were collected using a demographic questionnaire, the Snyder’s Adult Hope Scale (AHS), which was used to assess perceived life expectancy, and the Anxious Thoughts Inventory (AnTI). The intervention group received eight structured palliative care sessions. Following the final session, both groups completed the same questionnaires, and 78 participants were included in the final analysis. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26. Analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) was used to compare post-intervention outcomes after adjustment for baseline scores. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Results At baseline, the intervention and control groups had similar scores on both primary outcomes: anxious-thoughts scores (intervention: 54.17 ± 9.55; control: 53.35 ± 9.85; p = 0.710) and perceived life expectancy scores (intervention: 24.25 ± 5.87; control: 24.92 ± 5.50; p = 0.607). Post-intervention, palliative care significantly reduced anxious thoughts scores (intervention: 34.84 ± 8.91, control: 52.84 ± 9.87; F (1, 75) = 678.82, p < 0.001, Partial Eta Squared = 0.90) and increased perceived life expectancy (intervention: 30.61 ± 4.98, control: 25.17 ± 5.67; F (1, 75) = 204.19, p < 0.001, Partial Eta Squared = 0.73). Conclusion Our results suggest that palliative care, when used as an adjunct to standard physical treatments, is associated with reduced anxious thoughts and an increased perceived life expectancy. Trial registration Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT) IRCT20231223060506N1 registered on 21 January 2024.

title: Peran Pemberdayaan Masyarakat dalam Meningkatkan Kesejahteraan di Gampong Ujung Tanoh Darat, Kecamatan Meureubo, Kabupaten Aceh Barat
abstractText: Pemberdayaan masyarakat merupakan upaya untuk meningkatkan kemampuan dan kemandirian masyarakat dalam memanfaatkan potensi yang dimiliki guna meningkatkan kesejahteraan hidup. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pelaksanaan program pemberdayaan masyarakat serta peran pemerintah desa dalam mendukung kesejahteraan masyarakat di Desa Ujong Tanoh Darat, Kecamatan Meureubo, Kabupaten Aceh Barat. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif deskriptif dengan teknik pengumpulan data melalui wawancara dan dokumentasi. Informan penelitian terdiri dari dua orang, yaitu Sekretaris Desa Ujong Tanoh Darat dan salah seorang warga desa. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pemberdayaan masyarakat dilaksanakan melalui beberapa bidang, yaitu pertanian, peternakan, kesehatan, dan kegiatan sosial. Dalam bidang pertanian, pemerintah memberikan bantuan bibit padi dan pupuk subsidi melalui kelompok tani, tetapi penyalurannya belum merata. Dalam bidang peternakan, bantuan kambing dan kerbau menghadapi kendala berupa ternak yang hilang atau mati serta kurangnya keberlanjutan pengelolaan oleh sebagian penerima. Sementara itu, kegiatan pemeriksaan kesehatan gratis mendapatkan respons positif dari masyarakat. Pemerintah desa berperan sebagai fasilitator dan penghubung antara masyarakat dengan pihak luar melalui penyampaian informasi, penyediaan fasilitas, dan dukungan terhadap kegiatan sosial. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa program pemberdayaan masyarakat telah memberikan manfaat dalam bidang ekonomi, kesehatan, dan sosial. Namun, diperlukan peningkatan pemerataan bantuan, pendampingan, serta partisipasi dan tanggung jawab masyarakat agar program pemberdayaan dapat berjalan secara optimal dan berkelanjutan.

title: CONTRIBUIÇÕES DO ACOMPANHAMENTO PSICOLÓGICO PARA A ADAPTAÇÃO ÀS MUDANÇAS DECORRENTES DA CIRURGIA BARIÁTRICA
abstractText: A cirurgia bariátrica é uma intervenção utilizada no tratamento da obesidade e pode produzir mudanças físicas, metabólicas, psicológicas e sociais. A adaptação ao procedimento envolve mais do que a perda de peso, pois exige reorganização dos hábitos alimentares, da percepção corporal e da rotina de cuidados. Este artigo tem como objetivo analisar as contribuições do acompanhamento psicológico para a adaptação às mudanças decorrentes da cirurgia bariátrica, com atenção ao comportamento alimentar, à saúde mental, à imagem corporal e à adesão ao tratamento. Trata-se de uma revisão bibliográfica narrativa, de abordagem qualitativa e caráter descritivo-analítico, baseada em estudos científicos nacionais e internacionais relacionados à temática. A literatura examinada aponta que comportamentos alimentares problemáticos, sofrimento emocional, expectativas idealizadas e dificuldades de adaptação corporal podem persistir ou surgir ao longo do processo. Também indica que autoeficácia e suporte contínuo podem favorecer a adesão às recomendações, embora os resultados variem entre indivíduos e estudos. O acompanhamento psicológico pode contribuir para a identificação dessas demandas, o desenvolvimento de estratégias de enfrentamento e a elaboração das transformações, tanto no período pré-operatório quanto no pós-operatório. Conclui-se que a Psicologia integra o cuidado multiprofissional ao oferecer suporte individualizado e contínuo, sem que sua atuação seja compreendida como garantia de resultados específicos de perda de peso.

abstractText: Актуальность. Сахарный диабет 2-го типа (СД2) повышает риск развития сердечно-сосудистых осложнений, в том числе бессимптомных форм ишемической болезни сердца (ИБС). Цель — разработать клинико-функциональную схему изучения субклинической ишемии миокарда у молодых пациентов с СД2 и стабильной ИБС с учётом продолжительности сахарного диабета и кардиометаболических факторов риска. Материалы и методы. Представлен протокол планируемого наблюдательного исследования с участием 300 пациентов в возрасте 19–45 лет с СД2 и стабильной ИБС, находящихся под диспансерным наблюдением. Предусмотрено формирование трёх групп по 100 пациентов в зависимости от продолжительности СД2: 0–5, 6–10 и более 10 лет. Программа исследования включает клиническую оценку, определение гликемического и липидного профилей, электрокардиографию, эхокардиографию, нагрузочное тестирование по показаниям и оценку качества жизни. Результаты. Приведена характеристика планируемого дизайна исследования; индивидуальные результаты обследований и статистические показатели не представлены. В связи с этим частота бессимптомной ишемии и диагностическая эффективность применяемых методов на данном этапе не установлены. Заключение. Предлагаемый протокол направлен на изучение вклада продолжительности СД2 и кардиометаболических факторов риска в выявление субклинической ишемии миокарда, а также на обоснованный индивидуализированный выбор диагностических исследований. EN Background. Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) increases the risk of cardiovascular complications, including asymptomatic manifestations of coronary artery disease (CAD). Objective. To develop a clinical and functional framework for investigating subclinical myocardial ischemia in young patients with T2DM and stable CAD, taking into account diabetes duration and cardiometabolic risk factors. Materials and Methods. This article presents a planned observational study protocol involving 300 patients aged 19–45 years with T2DM and stable CAD who are receiving regular medical follow-up. Three groups of 100 patients each will be formed according to diabetes duration: 0–5, 6–10, and more than 10 years. The study protocol includes clinical assessment, evaluation of glycemic and lipid profiles, electrocardiography, echocardiography, exercise testing when clinically indicated, and assessment of quality of life. Results. The planned study design is described; individual patient findings and statistical data are not presented. Consequently, the prevalence of asymptomatic ischemia and the diagnostic performance of the assessment methods have not yet been established. Conclusion. The proposed protocol aims to investigate the contribution of T2DM duration and cardiometabolic risk factors to the identification of subclinical myocardial ischemia and to support the justified, individualized selection of diagnostic investigations. title: A novel framework for rapid short-term prediction of ship motions using an enhanced gradient boosting decision tree with dynamical evolution sequence
abstractText: Abstract Accurate short-term prediction of ship motions is essential for selecting operational areas and time windows, which are critical for maritime safety and operational efficiency. Traditional physics-based methods provide high accuracy but are computationally expensive, limiting their use in onboard applications. To address this challenge, this study proposes a rapid short-term prediction method for ship motions. The method utilizes a dynamical evolution sequence (DES) to generate a more uniform sample set, replacing the conventional Latin hypercube sampling (LHS) in the gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT), thus enhancing model accuracy through improved input sampling. First, four test functions are used to validate and compare the original and improved GBDT models. Results show that the DES-based GBDT model consistently outperforms the traditional LHS-based GBDT model across all functions. Based on this, the enhanced model is used to develop a comprehensive set of surrogate models for all hydrodynamic coefficients required for six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion prediction, including added mass, radiation damping, and wave excitation force, comprising 84 submodels in total. This innovation reduces computation time from hours to approximately 10 s per operating condition. The feasibility of the proposed method is validated under two loading conditions for an offshore support vessel, with prediction results compared to those obtained from the commercial software Hydrostar. The validation demonstrates that the 6-DOF motion amplitudes predicted by the proposed method align closely with those from the commercial software, achieving both rapid and accurate predictions. This method provides a viable alternative for rapid short-term ship motion prediction in engineering practice.

Advances in prediction of drug-target thermodynamics and kinetics: from molecular simulations to artificial intelligence
abstractText: In the drug discovery field, drug affinity has long been considered the gold standard for designing small compounds with therapeutic activity. However, since the beginning of the 21st century, kinetic parameters, which are directly related to compound efficacy, have increasingly been recognized as central to the rational design of new drugs. However, such data are scarce, while the experimental determination of the association and dissociation rate constants, k on and k off , is costly and time-consuming. Molecular simulations, such as Molecular Dynamics (MD) calculations have been proposed to predict those kinetic constants, despite known limitations. With the rapid development of AI-based tools, researchers are now proposing advanced methodologies that leverage both data-driven learning from existing datasets and physics-based modelling through MD simulations. This review presents a critical overview of MD-based approaches for estimating protein-ligand binding free energies and rate constants. It then examines data-driven prediction methods and ML-assisted molecular simulations, with particular attention to validation and current limitations. Finally, it discusses the crucial need for new data with respect to the FAIR principles and methodological developments needed to further improve prediction quality.

The Effect of English Term Retention in the Localization of RPG Games By Hoyoverse on the Aesthetic Perception of Young Indonesian Players
abstractText: The rapid growth of the global video game industry has prompted developers to localize their products for cross-cultural markets. However, many East Asian game developers, including HoYoverse, retain English terminology rather than fully translating it into local languages. Although previous studies have primarily examined localization strategies and functional and linguistic accuracy, the affective and aesthetic dimensions of language choice among Indonesian players remain underexplored. This study aims to investigate the effect of English term retention in HoYoverse's role-playing games (RPGs), including Honkai Impact 3rd, Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, and Zenless Zone Zero, on the aesthetic perceptions of young Indonesian players aged 15–25 who have played these games for at least six months and used Indonesian subtitles. A quantitative survey design was employed, involving 202 respondents recruited through purposive sampling. Data were collected using a five-point Likert scale and analyzed using validity and reliability tests and simple linear regression analysis in SPSS. The results indicate that English term retention has a positive and statistically significant effect on aesthetic perception (? = 0.651; t = 12.122; p < 0.001), accounting for 42.4% of the variance in aesthetic perception. The remaining 57.6% of the variance may be attributable to other factors, such as translation quality, voice acting, user interface and user experience (UI/UX) design, and individual English proficiency. These findings support the relevance of Venuti's foreignization framework to digital game localization and suggest that selectively retaining English terminology, supported by glossaries and customizable language settings, may enhance players' aesthetic perceptions while promoting inclusivity among players with varying levels of English proficiency.

title: USO DE AGONISTAS GLP1: UMA REVISÃO SOBRE SEGURANÇA E EFICÁCIA
abstractText: O crescimento exponencial da prevalência de sobrepeso e obesidade impulsionou o desenvolvimento de intervenções farmacológicas avançadas, destacando-se os agonistas do receptor do peptídeo semelhante ao glucagon-1 (GLP-1). Este trabalho teve como objetivo analisar as evidências científicas disponíveis na literatura acerca da segurança e eficácia do uso de agonistas de GLP-1 em pacientes não diabéticos. Trata-se de uma revisão integrativa da literatura desenvolvida a partir do levantamento de 14 artigos científicos que abordam a eficácia clínica, os perfis de tolerabilidade, as repercussões estético-dermatológicas e a sustentabilidade terapêutica. Os resultados indicam que fármacos como a semaglutida e a tirzepatida promovem reduções ponderais expressivas, variando entre 15% e mais de 20%, decorrentes da lentificação do esvaziamento gástrico e da modulação neuroendócrina dos centros de saciedade. Por outro lado, o perfil de segurança é marcado predominantemente por eventos adversos gastrointestinais (náuseas, vômitos e constipação), os quais demandam titulação gradual de dose e manejo clínico apropriado para evitar a descontinuação prévia. Destaca-se ainda que a rápida perda de gordura pode acarretar impactos na biologia cutânea e alterações periorbitais, enquanto a suspensão da medicação frequentemente resulta no reganho progressivo do peso perdido (weight regain). Conclui-se que os agonistas de GLP-1 constituem ferramentas terapêuticas altamente eficazes para o controle do peso em adultos não diabéticos, porém exigem uso racional, acompanhamento médico contínuo, supervisão multidisciplinar e associação sistemática com o exercício físico para a manutenção dos resultados no longo prazo.

DIFERENTES COMPOSTOS FLUORETADOS EM DENTIFRÍCIOS NA PREVENÇÃO E NO CONTROLE DA CÁRIE DENTÁRIA EM INDIVÍDUOS DE ALTO RISCO: REVISÃO INTEGRATIVA
abstractText: A cárie dentária concentra-se em indivíduos de alto risco, nos quais o dentifrício fluoretado é a principal medida preventiva, mas ainda não se sabe se os diferentes compostos fluoretados apresentam desempenho clínico distinto. Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar as evidências sobre a efetividade de dentifrícios contendo diferentes compostos fluoretados na prevenção e no controle da cárie dentária em indivíduos de alto risco. Trata-se de uma revisão integrativa, com busca nas bases PubMed/MEDLINE, BVS (LILACS e BBO) e SciELO, que incluiu ensaios clínicos publicados entre 2016 e 2026, com texto completo disponível gratuitamente. Dos 65 registros identificados, três ensaios clínicos randomizados foram incluídos, envolvendo crianças com cárie ativa e pacientes em tratamento ortodôntico. Os compostos avaliados foram o fluoreto de sódio e o monofluorfosfato de sódio. Em pacientes ortodônticos, o dentifrício com 5.000 ppm F reduziu a proporção de pacientes com novas lesões apenas na região estética. Em pré-escolares, a adição de arginina a 1,5% ao dentifrício com monofluorfosfato de sódio não trouxe benefício adicional, e, em crianças de 10 a 14 anos, um dentifrício sem flúor com arginina a 8,0% apresentou menor incremento de cárie que o controle com fluoreto de sódio. Nenhum estudo comparou diretamente compostos fluoretados em concentrações equivalentes. Conclui-se que as evidências não permitem estabelecer a superioridade de um composto fluoretado sobre outro em indivíduos de alto risco, sendo necessários ensaios clínicos que comparem diretamente esses compostos.

title: Supporting Children, Adolescents, and Families Experiencing Separation and Divorce: Clinical Report
abstractText: Parental separation and divorce are common and can be associated with a range of adverse outcomes for children and families. Pediatricians are well positioned to support children and families who are experiencing separation and divorce through providing anticipatory guidance and by helping parents support their children during this transition. Additionally, by promoting relational health with all families, pediatricians can support emotional well-being and resilience that may help in mitigating adversities, including separation and divorce.
